lines.text: One of these three people is lying. And the detective caught them with just one question!
My diamond necklace is gone! The power went out at exactly nine o'clock!
Nobody leaves this mansion until I find out what happened.
So. Where were you when the lights went out?
In the kitchen, sir, preparing dinner. I never left.
I was down in the basement checking the pipes. I even saw the lightning flash through the basement window!
I was upstairs folding laundry. I heard the thunder, but I didn't see anyone.
Interesting. Daniel, you saw the lightning through the basement window?
Yes! Clear as day. What's wrong with that?
Oliver was in the kitchen. Sophie was upstairs. And Daniel was in the basement, watching the lightning.
The detective only needed one look around. So, who is lying? And how did he know?
